items.name: Particle filter regeneration
items.desc: PLEASE READ ALL NOTES CAREFULLY!  This procedure allows regenerating the particulate filter (DPF) and it must be used if the particle led on the Dashboard turns ON or when a failure regarding the particle filter is found. This function generates very high exhaust temperatures, so it is necessary to verify that the exhaust tube is not obstructed.  The following conditions are required to perform the procedure:   - engine temperature >70°C   - vehicle stationary  - engine idling (850 rpm +/- 50 rpm)   - brake and clutch pedals released.  ATTENTION:  During the procedure DO NOT place the vehicle on flammable surfaces (ex. grass, etc.)    NOTE: If Forced Regeneration State shows 'Error' then the procedure has failed - stop engine an wait 15 seconds before repeating the procedure.  When Forced Regeneration State becomes 'OK' and Regeneration Progress becomes 100%:  - Turn the key to OFF  - Wait 15 seconds  - Turn the key to MAR  - Connect again and clear any errors.

items.name: Particle filter replacement
items.desc: PLEASE READ ALL NOTES CAREFULLY!  This procedure must be performed when the particulate filter (DPF) is replaced. It updates some of the parameters inside the ECU and resets the number of incomplete regenerations.  NOTE: The following conditions are required to perform the procedure:  - engine temperature >70°C  - vehicle stationary  - engine idling (850 rpm +/- 50 rpm)  - brake and clutch pedals released.  ATTENTION: During the procedure DO NOT place the vehicle on flammable surfaces (ex. grass, etc.)  NOTE: If Forced Regeneration State shows 'Error' then the procedure has failed - stop engine an wait 15 seconds before repeating the procedure.  When Forced Regeneration State becomes 'OK' and Regeneration Progress becomes 100%:  - Turn the key to OFF  - Wait 15 seconds  - Turn the key to MAR  - Connect again and clear any errors.

items.name: Particle filter replacement (E6D)

items.name: PROXI ALIGNMENT PROCEDURE
items.desc: The PROXI Alignment procedure is used to configure the modules connected to the CAN network of the vehicle. A flashing odometer indicates the the PROXI is not aligned properly. If your odometer flashes or you have added/removed/replaced CAN modules from your vehicle then you need to execute this procedure. The configuration is stored in Body Computer module and, if you replace this module it is recommended to make a backup of PROXI configuration before removing the original Body Computer module and then use write this configuration to the replaced Body Computer.  NOTE: Please read carefully all data on the "Info" screen. Check if available and configured modules correspond to your vehicle. Also, if the Info screen shows that added or removed ECUs are detected, check if those ECUs are detected correctly.  NOTE: Make sure that your 诊断软件 log files folder is configured properly as the program will write some important information about your current PROXI configuration and you may need this data in case of procedure failure.  NOTE: PROXI alignment may fail on the airbag module on some vehicles due to fastened seat belts or detected objects on the seats. Make sure that both seat belts are not fastened during the PROXI alignment. Also, if the car has rear seat belt switches then the rear seat belts should also be not fastened during the PROXI. Sometimes it could also be caused by the “passenger present” sensor on front right seat and it is recommended to not sit there (and not put heavy objects) during PROXI alignment.  WARNING: DO NOT INTERRUPT the procedure once it has started. The key should be ON/MAR and Engine OFF. After successfull execution of the procedure turn your key to OFF and wait at least 60 seconds before turning it back ON.  NOTE: On some models (GIULIA, STELVIO) the ABS module may be reset during PROXI procedure. You will have to connect to ABS mnodule and perform all calibration procedures.

items.desc: This procedure will flush the master cylinder hydraulic lines inside the ABS module. Perform the procedure after replacing the ABS unit, or when changing the brake fluid. items.name: Hydraulic unit bleed
items.desc: This procedure will flush the hydraulic lines of the ABS module. Perform the procedure after replacing the ABS unit, or when changing the brake fluid. Keep the brake pedal pressed during the entire procedure. The pedal will first sink to floor and then raise back to top.  Basically the procedure will open all drain valves and fill both accumulators with brake fluid from the master cylinder, then it will use the hydraulic pump to return all fluid back to master cylinder. This way the fluid will be cycled through all internal ABS hydraulic lines.  Before executing this procedure make sure that there is enough brake fluid in the reservoir and also loosen its cap.

items.name: Key programming
items.desc: This procedure allows the programming of FOBIK type keys in the RFH module. The FOBIKs have to be pre-programmed with body computer's secret codes in order to be recognized by the vehicle. Follow the instructions on screen and make sure you have ALL keys (up to 8) before starting the procedure.  WARNING: DO NOT RUN this procedure if you don't know what you are doing as this procedure may disable your keys! Make sure YOU HAVE ALL KEYS as you will have to program ALL of them.  WARNING: You will also need to enter the electronic key code of your vehicle in order to execute this function. You can request this code from official service or dealer. Please be careful and note that the Body Computer will block itself for 30 minutes after an incorrect code is entered 3 times.  The procedure should be executed with car turned OFF - you should not press the START button to switch ON or start the car!  NOTE: You may run this procedure in simulation mode to see how it works. Basically, you have to do the following:  1. Start the procedure  2. The system will ask you to prepare FOBIK 1 and click Y. After that you have to press the UNLOCK button on the FOBIK briefly once and wait. The system will confirm if the recognition of the FOBIK is successfull.  3. The system will ask you to insert FOBIK 2 and so on. This procedure can be repeated for up to 8 FOBIKs.  4. The system will finally store all recognized keys into the Radio Frequency Hub module (RFH) and will display a status of the whole procedure. You will still have a chance to abort the procedure before step 4 and restore the previous FOBIK data.  PLEASE NOTE that the FOBIKs not learned during the procedure will be disabled and it will not be possible to use them to unlock or start the car. These FOBIKs can be re-enabled by using the "Enable FOBIKs" procedure.  After the procedure: Disconnect the OBD cable, go out of car and test if all FOBIKs work.

items.name: 恢复保养提醒（Service due）
items.desc: 通过调大保养周期并执行保养归零，重新启用仪表的保养提醒显示。
items.warning: 本功能不改变「剩余保养次数」计数器（出厂 9，禁止写入更大值）。它恢复的是仪表的 Service due 倒计时显示。若需把次数补回 9，需联系经销商。
items.notes: 实现依据：保养归零例程的说明原文写明 "You can re-enable the function by increasing the service interval value"。流程 = 读 22 28 03 → 写 2E 28 03（单位 500km/步）→ 2F 55 69 01 → 校验 22 01 01。

items.name: NEXT SERVICE KM RESET
items.desc: The SERVICE DUE function informs about the drive distance and time available until the next service is due.  The information starts to appear on dashboard at every Key-On after less than 2000km or 30 days are left of the service due interval.   After the service mileage or time has expired, an appropriate message gets shown each time the Key is turned on.  After carrying out the required service work it is necessary to reset the Service Interval counter function.   If the vehicle is used in severe conditions or primarily in short trip and city driving, shorter intervals are beneficial.  NOTE: The service function will be disabled after 9 service resets (You can re-enable the function by increasing the "service interval" value in Adjustments section).  NOTE: For diesel cars with DPF filter you also have to connect to the engine ECU and execute "Oil Change" procedure!

items.name: Service interval
items.desc: This function allows you to set the service coupon interval (distance).

items.name: Set number of service coupons
items.desc: This function allows you to set the number of service coupons. It is set to 9 at factory, and the number decreases at each Service Interval Reset. When the number of service coupons reaches 0 the "Service due" functionality on the dashboard is disabled.  You can enable the "Service due" functionality again by setting a value greater than 0.  You can disable the "Service due" functionality by setting a value of 0.  WARNING: ON NEW MODELS (like Giulia, Stelvio, etc.) IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO WRITE HIGHER VALUE!!!!
items.warning: 新车型（Giulia / Stelvio 等）禁止写入比当前更大的值——这是仪表 ECU 的防回拨保护，并非工具问题。该计数器出厂为 9，每次「保养归零」递减；减到 0 后仪表的保养提醒会被禁用。写入小于或等于当前值可能生效；若目的是重新启用仪表保养提醒，请改用「恢复保养提醒（Service due）」。
